prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: a single orthographic image-to-3D reference of the SAME approved coralback whale for Tripo.
Input image: exact creature identity, anatomy, painted surface material, and coral shelf design to preserve. This is a camera rotation of one existing whale, never a new variant.
Preserve the original long heavy barrel-shaped slate teal-gray body, rounded broad blunt wedge-shaped head, small sober eyes, closed mouth seam, cream baleen throat with simplified lengthwise pleats, two thick paddle-shaped pectoral flippers, single small dorsal fin far behind the shelf, narrower tail stock and two wide horizontal notched tail flukes. Preserve original proportions and restrained stylized faceted sculpted game-model finish. Keep the same skin patches without adding new scars or arbitrary anatomy.
Preserve the broad FLAT pale limestone/coral platform on the back behind the head, cream round plate coral around its low irregular edges and sparse muted terracotta plate accents. Its middle stays empty and nearly level for the future separate chest. One taller short pale stone/coral knuckle sits at the rear-right rim of this platform, and an orange plate cluster sits at the left-front rim. These are fixed anatomical positions: do not move or mirror these objects when rotating the camera. Do not replace the platform with a big round island, spikes, rocks across the whole whale, buildings, treasure chest or a hole. Platform occupies shoulders and central upper back only.
Neutral horizontal straight swimming pose, head-tail axis level, body not bent, pectoral fins symmetrically angled outward and downward about 25 degrees, tail flukes spread horizontally in the same pose across views. Same model, same geometry, same pose.
Render only ONE whale and only ONE requested view. Orthographic camera, NO perspective foreshortening. Plain uniform light gray studio background, soft neutral even light, faint diffuse shadow at most. Entire whale visible with at least 8% empty margins, no cut-off fins or tail. No ocean, waterline, splash, boat, seabed, people, chest, props, text, labels, badges, watermark, grid or multiple panels.
